hooks.command: f=$(python3 -c 'import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get("tool_input",{}).get("file_path",""))'); REPO=/home/robofi/codes/phosphobot; case "$f" in "$REPO"/phosphobot/*.py) (cd "$REPO/phosphobot" && uv run --quiet ruff check --fix --quiet "$f" && uv run --quiet ruff format --quiet "$f") ;; "$REPO"/dashboard/*.ts|"$REPO"/dashboard/*.tsx|"$REPO"/dashboard/*.js|"$REPO"/dashboard/*.jsx|"$REPO"/dashboard/*.json|"$REPO"/dashboard/*.css|"$REPO"/dashboard/*.md) (cd "$REPO/dashboard" && npx --no-install prettier --write --log-level=warn "$f") ;; esac
